A comparison of engagement between people who attended an event in person and those who attended online, measured by the number of sessions each attended. surveyframe declares the analysis in advance (Independent samples t-test, Mann-Whitney U test) and reports it in APA 7.

## In SurveyStudio

In RStudio, open the Addins menu, choose **surveyframe: Try a demo** and pick `two_group`. The study opens on the Design screen. Plan shows each research question with its method and decision rule, Analyse runs them as declared, and Report writes the APA 7 report.

## In R

```r
d <- sframe_demo("two_group")
results <- run_analysis_plan(d$responses, d$instrument)
render_report(d$instrument, d$responses)
```

## What the report gives

| Research question | Method | What the report gives |
|---|---|---|
| Do in-person and online attendees reach a different number of sessions? | Independent samples t-test | The APA 7 sentence, its table and chart |
| Do in-person and online attendees differ in sessions attended, without assuming normality? | Mann-Whitney U test | The APA 7 sentence, its table and chart |

The demo's data is simulated, so the site shows no numbers. Run it in SurveyStudio or R to see the results, each marked as demonstration data.
